pages.title: How it works
pages.content: One invoice, four stages: apply online, upload the invoice with its delivery note, we confirm it with your customer, and 90% is paid the next working day.

pages.title: Pricing
pages.content: No setup, no monthly fee and no minimum volume. 1.4% of the invoice for the first 30 days, capped at 4.2%.

pages.title: Who it's for
pages.content: Makers, wholesalers and service firms in the EU that issue B2B invoices of €1,000–€150,000.

pages.title: Stories
pages.content: Three suppliers and the invoices they funded.

pages.title: About
pages.content: Azuke Finance B.V. was founded in Rotterdam in 2019.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content: Questions about applying, fees, your customer and what happens after funding.

pages.title: Apply
pages.content: Apply in three minutes: your company number, your IBAN and one invoice with its delivery note.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content: Haringvliet 92, 3011 TG Rotterdam, Netherlands. Mon–Fri 8:30–17:30 CET. +31 10 555 0192.

pages.title: Early access
pages.content: Invoice funding for suppliers in the UK and Switzerland is coming. Leave your email to hear first.
